questions.question: 5 persons P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). P and R are sitting at the extreme ends of the row. S is sitting to the immediate right of R. Q is sitting second to the left of P. What is the position of T in the given seating arrangement?

options.text: Second from the left end of the row
Third from the left end of the row
Second from the right end of the row
Third from the right end of the row

questions.solution:
According to the given information, five persons **P, Q, R, S,** and **T** are sitting in a row facing **North**.

**1.** **P** and **R** are sitting at the extreme ends of the row.

**2.** **S** is sitting to the immediate right of **R**.

**3.** **Q** is sitting second to the left of **P**.

4. Place the remaining person **T** in the vacant spot.

The only remaining position is the fourth one from the left.

**The final seating arrangement is:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84805f8c792b5716ad70bdccbc45f20e4c6b45b041231971c562fd8eb244e1ce.png] 

From the above arrangement, **T** is sitting at the **fourth** position from the left end, which is also the **second from the right end** of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: Height of 6 girls P, Q, R, S, T and U is compared. Height of no two girls is same. R is taller than only four girls. U is taller than both S and P. S and P both are taller than both Q and T. Who is the tallest girl among these 6 girls?
questions.solution:
Given:

Total girls: **6 (P, Q, R, S, T, and U)**.

'**R is taller than only four girls**': Since there are 6 girls in total, if **R** is taller than exactly four girls, there must be only one girl taller than **R**. The height hierarchy is: 1st > **R (2nd)** > 3rd > 4th > 5th > 6th.

'**U is taller than both S and P**': This can be represented as **U > S** and **U > P**.

'**S and P both are taller than both Q and T**': This means **S > Q**, **S > T**, **P > Q**, and **P > T**.

By combining these height relationships, we establish the following sequence: **U > {S, P} > {Q, T}**. This indicates that **U** is taller than at least four other girls (**S, P, Q, and T**).

Since **R** is taller than only four girls (which must be **S, P, Q, and T**) and **U** is taller than those same four girls, **U** must be the single girl who is taller than **R**.

The complete height order is: **U > R > (S, P) > (Q, T)**.

Therefore, **U** is the **tallest girl** among the group.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'**.</p

questions.question: In 12 hours, how many times minute and hour hands of a clock overlap?
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

The **minute hand** and the **hour hand** of a **clock** move at different speeds.

In **1 hour** (60 minutes), the **minute hand** covers 360°.

Angular speed of the **minute hand** = 360/60 = **6° per minute**.

In **12 hours** (720 minutes), the **hour hand** covers 360°.

Angular speed of the **hour hand** = 360/720 = **0.5° per minute**.

__Calculation:__

The **relative speed** of the minute hand with respect to the hour hand = 6° − 0.5° = 5.5

questions.question: Angle between minute hand and hour hand of a clock at 6:10 and 7:20 are J and K respectively. What is the absolute difference (in degrees) between J and K?
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

The hour hand covers 3600 in 12 hours.

Angular distance covered in 1 hour = 360/12 = 300

Angular distance covered in 60 minutes = 300

Angular distance covered in 1 minute = 1/20

__Calculation:__

The minute hand covers 360° in 60 minutes.

1 minute = 360/60 ⇒ 1 minute = 60

**Case 1: Angle J at 6:10**

Minutes = 10

Angle covered by the **minute hand** = 10 × 6 = 60°

Angle covered by the **hour hand** = 6 × 30 + 10 × 1/2 = 180 + 5 = 185°

Angle **J** = |185 − 60| = 125°

**Case 2: Angle K at 7:20**

Minutes = 20

Angle covered by the **minute hand** = 20 × 6 = 120°

Angle covered by the **hour hand** = 7 × 30 + 20 × 1/2 = 210 + 10 = 220°

Angle **K** = |220 − 120| = 100°

**Difference between J and K:**

**Absolute difference** = |J − K| = |125 − 100| = 25°

Hence, the absolute difference between J and K **is 25**.

**__Alternate Method__**

The angle between the **hour hand** and **minute hand** = |60H - 11M|over2

Where, H = hours and M = minutes.

For **J** (6:10): H = 6, M = 10

J = (60 times 6 - 11 times 10)over2 = 250/2 = **125°**

For **K** (7:20): H = 7, M = 20

K = (60 times 7 - 11 times 20)over2 = 200/2 = **100°**

Absolute difference = |125 − 100| = **25°**

Hence, the correct answer is **25**.</p

questions.question: The present ages of A, B and C are 20 years, 26 years and 32 years respectively. What was the ratio of ages of A, B and C, 8 years ago from present?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Subtract the **time gap** (8 years) from each **present age** to find past ages.

Ages 8 years ago → A: 12, B: 18, C: 24.

Find the **simplest ratio** by dividing each value by their **HCF** (6).

Ratio = (12 ÷ 6) : (18 ÷ 6) : (24 ÷ 6) = 2 : 3 : 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3 : 4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present age of **A** = 20 years

Present age of **B** = 26 years

Present age of **C** = 32 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c288d8371fdaa4dadcfc3b4bed7e326da144e4a27bbf3e29491eba1ebe10f48c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Age of **A** 8 years ago = 20 − 8 = 12 years

⇒ Age of **B** 8 years ago = 26 − 8 = 18 years

⇒ Age of **C** 8 years ago = 32 − 8 = 24 years

⇒ Required **Ratio** = Age of A : Age of B : Age of C

⇒ Ratio = 12 : 18 : 24

⇒ Dividing by common factor 6: (12/6) : (18/6) : (24/6)

⇒ Simplified Ratio = 2 : 3 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3 : 4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Age Problems Logic

If the present age is **x**, then the age **n** years ago is calculated as **x − n**, and the age **n** years hence is **x + n**.

Ratio Simplification

A ratio **a : b : c** is simplified by dividing all terms by their **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** to reach the lowest terms.

Constant Difference

The **difference** between the ages of two people remains **constant** regardless of the number of years passed or subtracted.</p

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 100 years. 10 years ago from present, their ages were in the ratio of 3 : 1. What will be the respective ratio of the ages of father and son after 12 years from present?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Sum of ages** 10 years ago = 100 − (10 × 2) = 80 years.

Divide 80 in the **ratio** 3 : 1 → Father = 60 years, Son = 20 years.

Ages 12 years from now = Ages 10 years ago + 22 years (10 + 12 gap).

Father = 60 + 22 = 82; Son = 20 + 22 = 42.

**Required Ratio** = 82 : 42 = 41 : 21.

**∴ The correct answer is 41 : 21.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Current **sum of ages** = 100 years. **Ratio** 10 years ago = 3 : 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3702f4a83a3d699c133200c8fb415589f229889d97fd47a848d03c6e07fb7bb.png] 

⇒ Let the ages of the **father** and **son** 10 years ago be 3x and x.

⇒ Their **present ages** will be (3x + 10) and (x + 10).

⇒ Sum of present ages: (3x + 10) + (x + 10) = 100.

⇒ 4x + 20 = 100 ⇒ 4x = 80 ⇒ x = 20.

⇒ Present age of father = 3(20) + 10 = 70 years.

⇒ Present age of son = 20 + 10 = 30 years.

⇒ Age after 12 years: Father = 70 + 12 = 82; Son = 30 + 12 = 42.

⇒ **Required Ratio** = 82 : 42 = 41 : 21.

**∴ The correct answer is 41 : 21.**

**__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals remains **constant** at any point in time.

Sum of Ages Shift

If there are 'n' people, the sum of their ages after 't' years increases by (n × t).

Ratio of Ages

Ratios of ages change over time, unlike the absolute difference which stays fixed.</p

questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of L and S is 7 : 4. After 10 years from present L's age will be 31 years. What will be the ratio of respective ages of L and S after 15 years from present?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**L's present age** = 31 − 10 = 21 years.

Given **Ratio** L : S = 7 : 4. Since 7 units = 21 years, then 1 unit = 3 years.

**S's present age** = 4 units = 4 × 3 = 12 years.

After 15 years, **L's age** = 21 + 15 = 36 and **S's age** = 12 + 15 = 27.

Required **Ratio** = 36 : 27 = 4 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 3.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **present ages** (L : S) = 7 : 4

**L's age** after 10 years = 31 years

**Formula Used:**

Present Age = Future Age − Time interval

Ratio = Value₁ : Value₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f84dbde9f5cfca4e20404bfc240aa65d16d0efdc5ab14f8d175f462f9118ef.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ L's **present age** = 31 − 10 = 21 years

⇒ Let the present ages be 7x and 4x

⇒ 7x = 21

⇒ x = 21 ÷ 7 = 3

⇒ S's **present age** = 4 × 3 = 12 years

⇒ L's age after 15 years = 21 + 15 = 36 years

⇒ S's age after 15 years = 12 + 15 = 27 years

⇒ Required ratio = 36 : 27

⇒ Dividing both sides by 9: 4 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 3.**

**__Additional Information__**

Constant Difference Property

The **difference between the ages** of two individuals remains constant regardless of how many years pass.

Ratio Scaling

When the actual value of one part of a **ratio** is known, the other values can be found by multiplying with the same **proportionality constant** (x).

Age Ratio Rule

To find the **future ratio**, always add the time interval to the **absolute ages** rather than adding the interval directly to the ratio parts.</p

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding the Planning Commission?
I. It was established in 1952.
II. The President of India was its chairperson.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither I nor II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Planning Commission** was established by an executive resolution of the **Government of India** on **March 15, 1950**. It was not established in **1952**, although the **First Five-Year Plan** was launched in 1951. **Hence, statement I is incorrect.**
 
• The internal hierarchy of the **Planning Commission** mandated that the **Prime Minister of India** serve as the **ex-officio Chairperson**. The **President of India** had no formal role in the leadership or day-to-day operations of the commission. **Hence, statement II is incorrect.**
 
• The body was created following the recommendations of the **Advisory Planning Board**, which had been set up in 1946 under the chairmanship of **K.C. Neogy**.
 
• Its primary mandate was to formulate **Five-Year Plans** for the most effective and balanced utilization of the country's material, capital, and human **resources**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evolution and Dissolution:**
 
 
• The **Planning Commission** was a **non-constitutional** and **non-statutory** body, meaning it was not created by the **Constitution** or an **Act of Parliament**.
 
• On **August 13, 2014**, the **Government of India** scrapped the commission to make way for a more contemporary structure.
 
• It was officially replaced by the **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) on **January 1, 2015**, which emphasizes **cooperative federalism**.
 
• The first **Deputy Chairperson** of the Planning Commission was **Gulzarilal Nanda**, while the last Deputy Chairperson was **Montek Singh Ahluwalia**.
 
• The **National Development Council (NDC)** was the body responsible for giving final approval to the **Five-Year Plans** formulated by the commission.

questions.question: Lakshadweep Islands are located in the ____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Arabian Sea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** is India's smallest **Union Territory** and is an archipelago consisting of **36 islands** located in the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• The total land area of the territory is approximately **32 square kilometers**, and it is located about **200 to 440 kilometers** off the **Malabar Coast** of **Kerala**.
 
• The islands are of **coral origin** and are classified as **atolls**, which are circular coral reefs that partially or completely enclose a lagoon.
 
• The administrative headquarters of **Lakshadweep** is located on the island of **Kavaratti**.
 
• The islands were originally known as the **Laccadive, Minicoy, and Amindivi Islands** until they were renamed **Lakshadweep** by an act of Parliament in **1973**.
 
• Only **10 islands** out of the 36 are inhabited, including **Agatti**, **Amini**, **Andrott**, **Bitra**, **Chetlat**, **Kadmat**, **Kalpeni**, **Kavaratti**, **Kiltan**, and **Minicoy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bay of Bengal**:

 
 
• Located to the east of the Indian peninsula, it houses the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**, which are **volcanic** in origin and represent the elevated portions of submerged mountain ranges.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Channels**:
 
 
• The **8 Degree Channel** separates the island of **Minicoy** (India) from the **Maldives**.
 
• The **9 Degree Channel** separates **Minicoy** from the main **Lakshadweep** archipelago.
 
• The **10 Degree Channel** separates the **Andaman Islands** from the **Nicobar Islands** in the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Ecology**:
 
 
• **Pitti Island** is an important site in the region as it serves as a **Bird Sanctuary** and is uninhabited by humans.
 
• The region is governed by an **Administrator** appointed by the **President of India** under **Article 239** of the Constitution.

questions.question: Megasthenes visited the court of Chandragupta Maurya as an ambassador sent by ____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seleucus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Megasthenes** was an ancient **Greek historian**, diplomat, and explorer who served as a **Hellenistic ambassador** to India during the 4th century BCE.
 
• He was dispatched to the court of **Chandragupta Maurya** by **Seleucus I Nicator**, the founder of the **Seleucid Empire** and one of the most powerful generals of **Alexander the Great**.
 
• The appointment of **Megasthenes** followed a peace treaty between **Seleucus I** and **Chandragupta Maurya** around **305 BCE**, which concluded their conflict over the **Indus Valley** territories.
 
• He resided in the **Mauryan capital** of **Pataliputra** (modern-day Patna) for several years, providing a detailed Western perspective on the **Mauryan administration** and Indian life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indica:**

 
 
• This is the title of the seminal book written by **Megasthenes**. Although the original text is lost, its contents are known through citations by later classical authors such as **Arrian**, **Strabo**, and **Pliny**.
 
• The book categorized Indian society into **seven classes** and described the absence of slavery in India, though modern historians suggest this was a misinterpretation of the **Shudra** status or debt bondage.
 
 
 
• **Seleucus I Nicator:**
 
 
• After the death of **Alexander** in **323 BCE**, he secured the eastern satrapies of the empire.
 
• In the settlement with **Chandragupta Maurya**, he received **500 war elephants**, which proved decisive in his victory at the **Battle of Ipsus** in 301 BCE.
 
 
 
• **Alexander the Great:**
 
 
• He invaded India in **326 BCE**, crossing the **Indus River** and fighting King **Porus** at the **Battle of the Hydaspes**, but his troops mutinied at the **Beas River**, forcing his retreat.
 
 
 
• **Harshvardhan:**
 
 
• He was a ruler of the **Pushyabhuti dynasty** who reigned much later, from **606 to 647 CE**. His court was visited by the famous Chinese traveler **Xuanzang**.

questions.question: Oxygen-rich blood from the lungs enters which of the following chamber of heart in humans?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Left atrium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The human heart is a **muscular organ** divided into four chambers: two upper **atria** and two lower **ventricles**, designed to prevent the mixing of **oxygenated** and **deoxygenated blood**.
 
• The process of **oxygenation** occurs in the **lungs**, where **carbon dioxide** is removed from the blood and **oxygen** is absorbed through the **alveolar-capillary membrane**.
 
• Once the blood becomes **oxygen-rich**, it travels from the **lungs** to the heart via the **pulmonary veins**; humans typically have four pulmonary veins.
 
• The **left atrium** is the specific chamber that receives this **oxygenated blood**, serving as a primary receiving station before the blood moves into the **systemic circulation**.
 
• From the left atrium, the blood passes through the **mitral valve** (also known as the **bicuspid valve**) into the **left ventricle**, which then pumps it to the rest of the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right Atrium**

 
 
• Function: Receives **deoxygenated blood** returning from the body tissues.
 
• Vessels: Blood enters via the **Superior Vena Cava** (from the upper body) and the **Inferior Vena Cava** (from the lower body).
 
 
 
• **Right Ventricle**
 
 
• Function: Pumps the **deoxygenated blood** to the **lungs** for purification.
 
• Vessel: Blood is ejected through the **pulmonary valve** into the **pulmonary artery**.
 
 
 
• **Left Ventricle**
 
 
• Function: Responsible for pumping **oxygen-rich blood** to every organ and tissue in the body.
 
• Structure: It has the **thickest myocardium** (muscle wall) among all chambers to generate the high **blood pressure** needed for **systemic circulation** through the **aorta**.
